 THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD  ON 29-08-2016, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED  THE FOLLOWING:
rs.
 K. VINOD CHANDRAN, J.
 ------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C) No. 819 of 2010 (B)
 ------------------------------------------
 Dated: 29th August, 2016  J U D G M E N T I have heard the learned Counsel appearing for the 3rd respondent and the learned Counsel appearing for the Panchayat.
2.

The prayer in the writ petition is to direct respondents 1 and 2, the Panchayat, to prohibit establishment of a Cashew factory and its operation using electric power without obtaining consent under Section 233 of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act, 1994 ('Act of 1994' for short) and the consent of the Kerala State Pollution Control Board.

3. The learned Counsel appearing for the 3rd respondent submits that both the consent under Section 233 of the Act of 1994 and consent of the Pollution Control Board has been obtained and the 3rd respondent has been carrying on the Cashew factory for some time and then disposed it of.
4. The learned Counsel for the Panchayat does not dispute such contention.
Ext.R3(m) is the D&O license from the Panhayat.
Ext.R3(n) is the license issued under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act by the Panchayat and Ext.R3(o) is the license issued by the Department of Factories and Boilers.
The final fitness certificate is also evidenced at Ext.R3(p).
Ext.R3 (i) is the consent of the Pollution Control Board.
The Writ Petition hence is dismissed as infructuous.

Sd/-
